scope: all 314 technical validity/applicability uses of the važ-family, all 25 mathematical uses of the plat-family, and all 87 inherited or EDIT-0004-generated sut pravdive predicates in the four editable v019 Latin components
choice: Remove the invalid technical sense of važiti (officially weigh/balance) and the invalid mathematical sense of platiti (officially pay). Use context-specific truth, satisfaction, applicability, force, interpretation, and display-introduction constructions for 42 exact sentence loci, and the transparent analytic predicate imaje město/imajut město for the remaining 311 bare mathematical predicates. Repair 14 malformed or semantically wrong sut pravdive sentences and retain 73 that have an explicit grammatical plural subject.
alternatives_rejected: retain the South-Slavic mathematical extension of važiti as a reader-wide default despite its absence from the official sense inventory and its poor West/East transparency
adopt Czech/Slovak mathematical platiti even though the official common-language sense is pay
replace every occurrence by one global truth adjective without regard to equation truth, condition satisfaction, theorem applicability, or remains-in-force semantics
leave the malformed EDIT-0004 outputs for a hypothetical human reviewer
motivation: National mathematical predicates diverge sharply: Czech/Slovak platí, Croatian vrijedi, Polish zachodzi/ma miejsce, Slovene velja, and Bulgarian often uses fulfillment constructions. No single inherited verb is evenly transparent. Context-specific pravdivy, izpolniti, priměnjati and v silě plus the analytic imaje město avoid knowingly imposing one national extension and make the mathematical relation explicit.
